content: Task ledger update: Hermes Agent activation check verifies Discord gateway surfaces. Extended annunimas-cli utility hermes-agent-gateway-activation-check to verify the Annunimas Discord bot exposes /gateway action:activation_check and /gateway action:record_receipt, and that the receipt surface preserves gateway_result_is_not_approval. Current output reports discord_gateway_surface.ready=true, safe_local_ready=true, live_ready=false pending live env values and gateway start. Verification: cargo fmt --check -p annunimas-cli -p annunimas-hermes; cargo test -p annunimas-cli hermes_agent_gateway_activation_check -- --nocapture; cargo test -p annunimas-hermes serenity_bot -- --nocapture; cargo run -p annunimas-cli -- utility hermes-agent-gateway-activation-check.
